card.name: Spots where 'compete' is likely next
card.fires_on: Points where a word beginning with 'comp-' or 'con-' could come next, such as after 'out-', or a space before a number or superscript. The strongest case is 'out-comp(ete)' in lawn text.

modes.label: After out-
modes.description: The word 'out' or a hyphenated 'out-' stem where 'compete' or another 'out-' verb follows.
modes.example: and<< out>>-build the rest of the world.

modes.label: Start of 'concurrent'
modes.description: The piece 'con' opening 'concurrent use' inside a parenthesis in a drug-interaction list.

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: A space or digit before a number or superscript in dose, reference or year text.
modes.example: cumulative dose of cisplatin exceeded 300 mg/m<< >>2 .

card.writes: It pushes the model toward 'compete', 'competitive' and 'competition' words.
card.plain: It fires where a word like 'compete' might come next, and also on some spaces before numbers in drug labels.
